relevance_note: Single case report of an in-scope person with the disease: 'Ms. A was diagnosed with SSADH deficiency following the diagnosis of her younger brother with the same condition.'
method_note: Paper read in full (case report, no tables, no supplementary material; nothing was transcribed by script). One in-scope person, Ms. A (the paper's own label, used throughout; she is the single patient of the case report, so is_proband = true). Her younger brother, mentioned once as 'the diagnosis of her younger brother with the same condition', is a relative described in relation to her, but the paper gives no individual-level fact beyond that diagnosis (no sex, age, variant or feature), so per the scope rule he got no row. Variants: no ALDH5A1 variant is printed for Ms. A ('Genotyping was not performed.'), so her single variants row keeps variant_original_string = 'not reported' and every variant-level field is not reported/null. The Knerr et al. [9] individual described in the Discussion ('describe one individual whose anxiety and OCD symptoms responded positively to fluoxetine ...') is a previously published person with no label, sex, age or variant and only a treatment statement, so no row was created; Knerr et al. and Lapalme-Remis et al. cohorts are counts only. No contradictions found. Judgement calls: (1) 'Delayed developmental milestones and seizures were noted from an early age' was taken as the onset statement for epilepsy/global developmental delay, and the age at diagnosis ('At 12 years of age') was kept only in age_at_diagnosis_*; (2) hypersomnolence (a mirtazapine side effect) and the restricted affect were NOT recorded as sleep disturbance or depression/mood fluctuation, and 'hypersomnolence' is the reason those checklist items are not reported rather than excluded; (3) no normal/negative investigation was used to exclude an abnormality beyond the negated findings themselves ('There were no psychotic phenomena', 'Delusions and hallucinations were not apparent.').

span: Her only treatment at this time was lamotrigine 75 mg bd.
Ms. A commenced the serotonergic medication escitalopram, which was gradually up-titrated from 10 mg to 70 mg od.
the adjuncts risperidone 0.5 mg od, methylphenidate 5 mg od, mirtazapine 7.5 mg od were added cumulatively
